title: Entropy-Wasserstein regularization, defective local concentration and a cutoff criterion beyond non-negative curvature
summary: Notions of positive curvature have been shown to imply many remarkable properties for Markov processes, in terms, e.g., of regularization effects, functional inequalities, mixing time bounds and, more recently, the cutoff phenomenon. In this work, we are interested in a relaxed variant of Ollivier's coarse Ricci curvature, where a Markov kernel $P$ satisfies only a weaker Wasserstein bound $W_p(μP, νP) \leq K W_p(μ,ν)+M$ for constants $M\ge 0, K\in [0,1], p \ge 1$.
